sources.title: Data sources
sources.description: Offered are the motorways and the sources whose region touches this area.

data_description.sources: Which sources to show in this area, e.g. only the motorway for a commute.

roads.title: Motorways
roads.description: Which motorways to consider in this area. Only their events within the circle are shown.

data.jam_threshold: Traffic jam counts as disruption from

data_description.roads: The Autobahn API always returns a whole motorway and cannot search by area – hence this selection.
data_description.jam_threshold: For “Disruption active” and new/ended events: traffic jams with a smaller travel time loss are ignored (0 = every jam). Closures and accidents always count.

directions.title: Directions of travel
directions.description: Only show motorway events in these directions. Leave empty for all directions. Events without a clear direction (e.g. junction ramps) are always shown. On a commute the direction name can change at a motorway junction, e.g. “Singen -> Stuttgart” and then “Stuttgart -> Heilbronn”.
